title: Lethe
author: Pritha Chakraborty
stanzas: And yet the desire to remember;
And yet the craving for a warm touch
text:
Let the Forgetting be There
Let there be forgetting
And yet the desire to remember;

Down flows the tide

Eternal amnesia
Or strife to retain
The tussle goes on
Between Eros and Thanos

Man`s desolation
And yet the craving for a warm touch

To live on
Or
To leave....
